meta.description: The ToyVerse: the ToyChain blockchain with its coin TOY, the TOYPAY wallet, the ToyScan explorer, the invisible euro coin ToyCash and the learning game TOYQUEST.

ui.languageHint: The website is currently available in {n} of the 45 languages of wallet, TOYPAY and ToyScan. The others will follow.
ui.ctaText: Ask questions, test early, or become a merchant or mentor.
ui.disclaimer: No investment advice, no promise of returns. The ToyChain runs as a testnet under development; testnet TOY have no value. ToyCash, ToyScan and the TOYQUEST items are concepts. Numbers in the simulations are examples.

start.u: Game, wallet and a blockchain of its own in a world from the Arabian Nights.
slides: Game, wallet and a blockchain of its own in a world from the Arabian Nights.
In TOYQUEST, characters explain how TOY comes into being.
TOYPAY and ToyCash are meant to work offline as well.
start.what: What would you like to do?
tiles: Discover TOYQUEST: world, clans, time travel.
start.statusText: The ToyChain is being built step by step as a testnet. {done} of {total} milestones are done.
start.newText: The overview shows how game, wallet and chain work together.

verse.u: Six building blocks under one roof.
cards: A lean blockchain of its own with the coin TOY. Runs on old phones and Raspberry Pi.
Wallet and node in one, for Android, Windows, Linux and Raspberry Pi.
Explorer with a warning light that keeps checking whether the rules are kept.
The game in Arabian Nights style, with a learning world about the technology.
Private euro cash on the net, offline too.
One inbox for all channels, invoices in TOY, protection against fraud.
verse.after: On top of that: an open economic cycle, merchants, mentors and community nodes. More

steps: You complete missions and learn in TOYQUEST how the ToyChain works.
If you like, you mint an item you earned through TOYPAY.
Minted items live as NFTs on Polygon. The ToyChain itself only knows TOY.
The wallet is also a node: it computes, signs and can earn TOY.
ToyScan checks emission, cap and rules and shows the result as a traffic light.
ToyCash is meant to live inside TOYPAY later, offline too.
For ToyCash, the ToyChain only witnesses checksums, no amounts and no names.

toyquest.u: An adventure that explains the technology to you.
rows: Five maps matching five design themes, every building can be entered, used and traded.
Offline or online, cooperative or competitive, with voice chat, risk mode and spectator mode.
Characters in many places explain the ToyChain step by step: short, normal, or technical with real numbers.
If you activated a level in TOYPAY, places in the game show real events of your node. Otherwise a clearly marked demo mode runs. The game itself never creates TOY.
You earn items by playing; you cannot buy them. If you like, you mint them as NFTs on Polygon. A shared pot pays the network fee.

steps: You complete missions, mini games and challenges.
You get items in the game, not in a shop. No pay to win.
If you like, you mint the item. The small fee covers the network costs.
The NFT is created on Polygon; the shared pot pays the gas.
The item is yours. In the game it works without an NFT too.

zeit.u: Five levels from antiquity to the present.
zeit.note: Levels 1 to 3 show ancient machines. Levels 4 and 5 add the leap into modern times as an outlook. Every level solves the same step, checking signatures, with a more efficient method. The numbers are examples.

maschinen.u: 50 ancient machines, up to 256 in the final version.
cards: Every machine has a master who explains the matching ToyChain process.
Collecting knowledge earns knowledge seals, master certificates, ducats and cosmetics. It never earns TOY.
From the workshop to the automaton, every machine linked to a process, for example the water clock and block time.

gangs.u: Strong alone, stronger as a team.
cards: Characters complement each other through traits, skills and items.
Teamwork with other players for challenges and level-ups.
Sultans and kings compete or cooperate. Characters serve them; your loyalty counts.
A gate only opens when two thirds of the gang set their seal, just like finality on the ToyChain.

steps: Traits, skills and items of the members reinforce each other.
The gang takes on a task together.
You pledge yourself to one of the five clans. They compete or cooperate.

salon.u: Hidden in the game, full of cards.
rows: You play with ducats from the game. Stakes in ToyCoin only come if a legal review allows them.
20 mini games plus missions and bonus levels.

steps: The game salon is a hidden building in the game.
Texas Hold’em or Limit 4-card Omaha, as a cash game or tournament.
You stake ducats. There are no real-money stakes without a legal review.

toypay.u: The wallet for the ToyVerse and a ToyChain node at the same time.
cards: Android, Windows, Linux and Raspberry Pi, including older devices.
You choose a level. Computing only happens on charger, Wi-Fi and normal temperature.
Encrypted via QR, NFC or Bluetooth, even without a network.
With a point-of-sale mode for merchants.
Preview before every signature, protection against address traps, phishing warning list, hardware wallets.
45 languages and four modes, from beginner to expert.

steps: The till sends the amount to your wallet as a payment request.
Before signing, the wallet shows you exactly what will happen.
The payment goes to the network and is final after one block.
The business account receives the confirmation.
Without a network, the encrypted payment goes straight from device to device.

toycoin.u: The currency of the ToyChain, with the same rules for everyone.
rows: At most 100,000,000 TOY, never more. The cap is part of the ToyChain’s constitution.
The first block contains not a single TOY. No reserve, no presale, no team share.
All TOY come into being gradually through work in the network: first epoch 50,500 TOY, first year about 16.8 million, half-life about 3.76 years, about 99 % after 25 years.
50 % to everyone who signs blocks, 40 % to the work lottery, 10 % to the refund pool for free transactions.
No TOY is ever destroyed on the ToyChain, and accounts are never lost.
18 decimals, Ethereum-style addresses. Chain ID testnet 7630714, mainnet 7630713 only after an audit.
toycoin.chartLabel: Year {y}: about {m} million TOY issued (plan at factor 1)
toycoin.warnText: On Polygon and Ethereum there are older tokens named ToyCoin. They are not ToyChain TOY; they will not be swapped or bridged. Wallet and ToyScan label them “Not ToyChain TOY, not exchangeable”. Do not buy them expecting a swap.

wallet.u: Once the public testnet runs, you add it here with one click.
wallet.btn: Add testnet · coming with milestone M10
facts: Your usual Ethereum address and recovery phrase work here too.
wallet.text: Adding the network works with any wallet that can add networks per EIP-3085, such as TOYPAY or MetaMask. The page reads nothing and cannot send anything. Testnet TOY have no value and are never carried over to a mainnet.
wallet.safety: This page never asks for your recovery phrase. Anyone who asks for it wants to defraud you.

steps: The page suggests the network with name, chain ID and access point.
Your wallet shows the data and you confirm. Keys never leave your device.
On the testnet your device computes tickets for the work lottery or gets test TOY from the testnet faucet.
With testnet TOY you safely try transfers, the free quota and the levels.

toycash.u: The feel of cash on the net, backed by euros.
rows: A euro stablecoin. Only you see holdings and amounts, in your wallet. The ToyChain only witnesses checksums, no amounts and no names.
Euro reserves, euro only at first. Own issuer, later several guardians together.
First a prototype on the eCash principle with test euros, later zk notes.
Multi-use, group and bearer vouchers, step by step.
Recall period, fraud penalty and reservation, step by step.
Concept. Real euros only after an audit and a legal review.

steps: A passes notes to B, offline too.
B swaps them at the issuer for new notes. The issuer checks that no note is used twice.
Each epoch the issuer anchors a checksum of its list on the ToyChain, so nothing can be changed secretly.

offline.u: The limit grows slowly with your use.
steps: 180 days and 100 payments, only with a device-bound key
365 days and 250 payments, only with a device-bound key
offline.text: Within the unlocked level you choose your limit yourself. The limit also acts as a deposit: whoever double-spends offline loses it to the people harmed. The level values are a proposal.

toychain.u: Lean like Mina, addresses like Ethereum.
rows: Every standard node stores at most 256 MB.
Runs on old Android devices, Raspberry Pi, Linux and Windows.
Same addresses and the same 12 or 24 words as Ethereum.
Level 0 needs no balance: your device computes tickets for the work lottery. With 10, 100 or 1,000 TOY stake you sign, store or validate.
A committee of up to 128 members signs every block. At two thirds it is final, about one block per minute.
Accounts are never lost. Accounts unused for a long time go dormant and can be woken at any time.
No tokens, no NFTs, no smart contracts on the ToyChain. Every function is built in.
Only reviewed methods and libraries. Post-quantum additional keys (ML-DSA) are planned for milestone M13.
toychain.chainHint: Move your pointer or finger over the scene to turn it. The cubes are example blocks.

steps: Your transaction lands in the pool.
A randomly chosen committee member assembles the block.
The committee signs. At two thirds the block is final.
Nodes keep the state and a short window, at most 256 MB.
New TOY go to signers, the work lottery and the refund pool.

mint.u: Send devices into the network and watch blocks appear.
mint.text: Simplified: work and signatures travel along the belt into the pool. When it is full or about a minute has passed (sped up here), a block is created. In the first epoch each block adds about 35 new TOY: 50 % for signers, 40 % for the work lottery, 10 % for the refund pool.

tx.u: 10 to 100 free transactions per account and day.
tx.text: Above the quota you pay a small fee or compute a ToyWork ticket. The fee doubles with every 10 further transactions in the same block, up to 1,024 times. Fees go 40 % to active participants, 40 % to the refund pool and 20 % to the block proposer.

toyscan.u: Green light when all rules are kept.
cards: Never more than 100,000,000 TOY. In every block, the sum of all balances equals the sum of all emissions.
The first block contains 0 TOY. Every TOY can be traced back to an emission.
Every epoch is recalculated against the formula.
Shows balances of the same address on other chains, read-only. Old ToyCoin tokens are labelled “not ToyChain TOY”.

steps: ToyScan reads supply, epochs and blocks of the ToyChain.
An archive node adds up all balances itself.
Balances of the same address on other chains appear for information only.
Green when everything adds up. Yellow for anomalies, red for a broken rule, with evidence.

ketten.u: The same address everywhere, without a bridge.
rows: Your ToyChain address also works on Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum, Base and BNB Chain. TOYPAY shows balances, tokens and NFTs there.
An atomic swap with a hash time lock: either both sides get their money or neither does. Planned for milestone M12.
The tokens named ToyCoin on Polygon and Ethereum are not ToyChain TOY and cannot be exchanged.
There is no bridge in the current scope. If one came later, it would need its own decision, an audit and a legal review.

roadmap.u: The order matters more than dates.
roadmap.progress: ToyChain phase 1: {done} of {total} milestones done (as of {date})
cards: Node in Rust: emission, cryptography, transactions and fees are done; consensus is next.
Wallet with levels and energy mode on four platforms.
Local first, then public, with load tests.
Explorer with warning light and open interface.
Learning world and items on Polygon, independent of the ToyChain core.
Prototype with test euros, then offline wallet and zk notes.
Only after an external audit, load tests and a legal review, announced publicly beforehand.

steps: Emission, cryptography and transactions are built and tested.
TOYPAY brings the chain to phones, PCs and Raspberry Pi.
Local first, then public, with load tests and fuzzing.
Audit, load tests and legal review are mandatory. Testnet TOY are never carried over.

community.u: An economic cycle carried by everyone.
cards: Merchants with a business account, till, vouchers and loyalty points.
Experienced players help newcomers and earn knowledge seals for it.
Providing a device strengthens the network. Raspberry Pi kits and a node map are planned.
ToyScan shows the economic cycle with real numbers, without forecasts.
Comes later. Even then, nobody can change the ToyChain’s constitution.

datenschutz.u: What happens to your data: as little as possible.
datenschutz.template: This is a template. It fits a static site without cookies or tracking. Add the hosting provider and have it reviewed legally before publishing.
sections: The site is hosted by {host}. When you visit, the server processes technically necessary data such as IP address, time and requested page in order to deliver the site and protect it against attacks (Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR).
The site sets no cookies, uses no analytics and loads no content from third parties. The fonts are served from our own server.
The simulations run only in your browser. Nothing is sent to us.
The contact form only opens your e-mail program. Only when you send the e-mail do we receive it, and we use it only to reply (Art. 6 (1) (b) and (f) GDPR).
Links, for example to block explorers, lead to other providers. Their privacy notices apply there.
You have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, data portability and objection, and the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection authority.

levels: The master of reckoning slides the beads and checks every signature by hand.
A water wheel drives the hammer, and many seals become one.
The water clock sets the beat, like the block time of about one minute.
Archive and minting · outlook: modern era
The ancient coin press becomes the steam press: minting to the beat of the machine.
Heron’s automaton followed fixed rules. Today many cores check signatures at the same time.

gears.title: Mechanics to turn
gears.label: Four meshing gears
gears.text: Gear 4 turns {x} times as fast as the crank, in the opposite direction.

npc.title: Meet the characters
npc.intro: Tap a figure and ask a question. The dialogues are examples.
npc.hello: Welcome! What would you like to know?
qa: What does an item cost?
You earn items in the game. Only if you want to mint one as an NFT do you pay a small fee for the network costs.
Can I trade with you?
All buildings and goods can be traded. With a business account you can even take payments at the till.
What is TOY?
The currency of the ToyChain. All 100 million come into being gradually through work in the network. There is no reserve.
How do I find the game salon?
The building is hidden. Walk through the city attentively and you will find it.
Who can play?
Offline alone, online with others, together or against each other. You can watch in spectator mode.
Is it safe?
Never give away your recovery phrase, not even to me. Whoever asks for it is a fraudster.
How is a block made?
Transactions gather. About every minute a committee member assembles a block and the others sign. At two thirds it is final.
Why does the chain stay small?
Every node stores at most 256 MB. Accounts unused for a long time go dormant and can be woken at any time. Nothing gets lost.
What is ToyCash?
Digital euro cash whose amounts only you can see. It is meant to work offline too.
What does a clan give me?
Loyalty is rewarded. Five clans compete or cooperate, and their characters serve them.
How many clans are there?
Five sultans, kings and clans, matching the five maps.
What is a hero NFT?
You will be able to mint your hero as an NFT later. The fee covers the network costs; the details are still open.
How do we travel together?
As a gang or with other open-world players. Traits, skills and items complement each other.
What is the time travel?
Five levels from antiquity to the present show the ToyChain processes with ever better methods.
Where can I practise?
In the training level. There are also 20 mini games, missions and bonus levels.

poker.title: Poker at the table
poker.ruleHoldem: Hold’em: you use the best 5 of your 2 cards and the board.
poker.ruleOmaha: Omaha: you must use exactly 2 of your 4 cards and 3 from the board.
poker.start: New hand. Everyone pays {n} ante. Bet, call or fold.
poker.newCards: {street}: new cards are on the table.
poker.allFold: Everyone else folded. You win {n} ducats.
poker.broke: Your stack is empty. You get new ducats to practise.
poker.foot: Limit poker with fixed bet sizes: small bet before and on the flop, double bet on turn and river. The opponents are example characters with a simple strategy. Played with ducats only.

mint.start: Send devices into the network and watch the pool fill up.
mint.full: More than 8 devices do not fit on the table.
mint.phone: A phone computes slowly, but every device counts. Without a balance it takes part in the work lottery.
mint.pi: A Raspberry Pi works steadily and economically.
mint.pc: A PC fills the pool fastest. Raw computing power alone brings nothing in consensus, though.
mint.spamMsg: Spam barely fills the pool but costs a fee or computing work.
mint.block: Block {k} final: {n} contributions, {t} new TOY (consensus {a}, work {b}, refund pool {c}).
mint.label: Minting machine

tx.sentFee: Quota used up: fee about {fee} TOY (factor {f}), or a ToyWork ticket makes it free.

offline.limit: Offline limit: {used} of {cap} € · level {s} · {days} days, {n} payments
offline.over: Limit reached: {n} € no longer fit. Go online to free your limit again.
offline.paid: {n} € transferred encrypted from device to device, without any network.
offline.double: The same note went out a second time. Offline, nobody notices yet.
offline.caught: Double spend detected: the issuer rejects the second note, and the ToyChain makes this verifiable. Whoever double-spends loses the deposit to the person harmed and is moved down a level.
offline.synced: {n} payment(s) confirmed. Your offline limit is free again.
offline.monthMsg: One month of use: 30 days and 60 payments. Your limit grows level by level.
offline.label: Two phones exchange an encrypted payment offline

toyscan.bigRed: Big red light: cap, fair launch or constitution violated.
criteria: A1 Cap and sum of all balances
A2 Fair launch: every TOY from an emission
scenarios: More TOY would have been issued than allowed. This must never happen.
A balance cannot be traced back to any emission.
Issuance is more than 3 % ahead of the plan. Not a broken rule, but unusual.
The latest data are older than 10 minutes or two sources disagree.

voucher.title: Try vouchers
voucher.own: Or build your own: choose a type

i: Whoever holds it can redeem it. The first customer gets the full amount.
m: The value is split over several redemptions until it is used up.
g: Only the chosen members can redeem, each exactly once with an equal share.

voucher.hint: After creating it, tap a customer to redeem.
voucher.doneI: The bearer voucher has already been redeemed.
voucher.dblBoth: Both redemptions count here, because the voucher allows several.
voucher.dblCaught: Two devices, one note: the second redemption is rejected. Double spend detected.
voucher.foot: Example scenario. The issuer keeps the state of every voucher and the ToyChain makes it verifiable, so a copy is useless.
